name: Lobomon
main_effect:
You may digivolve this card from your hand onto one of your yellow Tamers as if that card is a level 3 yellow Digimon.
[When Digivolving] If [KendoGarurumon] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards or you have a black or purple Digimon or Tamer, this Digimon may digivolve into [AncientGarurumon] in the hand for a digivolution cost of 3, ignoring its digivolution requirements. If digivolved by this effect, delete this Digimon at the end of the turn.
source_effect: [When Attacking] If you have 7 or fewer cards in your hand, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
